info.name: spectroscope REST API
info.description:
The whole REST surface of spectro-server — 48 endpoints in 16 folders, one per area.

Every request targets {{baseUrl}} = http://{{host}}:{{port}} — change host/port once in the collection variables to re-target everything.

The chat/run stream (/ws) and the PTY shell (/ws/shell) are WebSocket endpoints, origin-checked at handshake time. They are not REST and are not part of this collection.

## The fences, measured

Measured with curl from loopback against a live spectro-server built from this tree (port 8199, 2026-07-30). A browserless REST client (no Origin header) passes every fence as long as it connects to loopback and targets localhost/127.0.0.1 in the URL.

| endpoint | fence | no Origin | localhost Origin | evil Origin | evil Host |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET /api/sessions | none | 200 | 200 | 200 | 200 |
| GET /api/settings | host | 200 | 200 | 200 | 404 |
| GET /api/leveling | host+origin | 200 | 200 | 404 | 404 |
| POST /api/leveling/tick | host+origin | 200 | 200 | 404 | 404 |

Every fence refusal is a blank 404, never a 403, so a refused caller cannot fingerprint the server.

## Variables

- `{{host}}` = `localhost` — Server host. The host fences require localhost/127.0.0.1/::1 here — a LAN IP answers 404 on every host-fenced endpoint.
- `{{port}}` = `8080` — spectro-server port. 8080 is the default; change once to re-target every request.
- `{{baseUrl}}` = `http://{{host}}:{{port}}` — Composed base URL. Every request targets {{baseUrl}}.
- `{{sessionId}}` = `20260730-120000-abcdef12` — A stored session id, shape [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9-]*. Take a real one from GET /api/sessions.
- `{{nodeId}}` = `node-1` — A fleet node id. Take a real one from GET /api/fleet.
- `{{skillName}}` = `brainstorming` — A skill name from GET /api/skills.
- `{{bundleId}}` = `five-lines` — A starter-bundle id from GET /api/bundles: five-lines | fleet | multi-agent.
- `{{localModelId}}` = `qwen3-4b` — A built-in model id from GET /api/local-model/catalog: qwen3-1-7b | qwen3-4b | qwen2-5-coder-7b | qwen3-8b | vibethinker-3b.
- `{{imageFile}}` = `0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef.png` — A content-addressed image name, [0-9a-f]{64}.(png|jpg|webp). Take a real one from a generate_image tool result.
- `{{transcriptPath}}` = `-Users-you-project/session.jsonl` — A Claude Code transcript path from GET /api/claude/transcripts.
- `{{workspaceFilePath}}` = `README.md` — Root-relative file path inside the workspace, for GET /api/file.
- `{{scaffoldDir}}` = `/tmp/spectro-scaffold` — An existing target folder for POST /api/bundles/{id}/scaffold.

## Handle with care

- **DELETE /api/sessions/{id}** — This really deletes the session, and it is the one destructive endpoint without an origin fence — the id shape check is the only guard. Point it at a throwaway home before replaying the whole collection.
- **POST /api/local-model/download** — Downloads are gigabytes — do not include this in an automated replay.
- **DELETE /api/skills/{name}** — Deletion is permanent — the seeding ledger will not re-seed it.
- **POST /api/pick-workspace** — Blocks until a human answers the dialog on the server machine — exclude it from automated replays.
- **POST /api/fleet/nodes** — Requires the server to run with SPECTRO_ALLOW_SPAWN set AND a running hub — otherwise every answer is 404, by design.
- **POST /api/explain** — Spends the operator's API key on every call.

item.name: health & doctor
item.description: Reachability, the rolling server log, and the scheduler's job state.

request.description:
Health probe; always {"status":"ok"} — reachability IS the signal.

Fence: none — No origin gating.

Writes state: no

query.description: optional. byte cursor from the previous poll
optional. tail lines for the no-offset form, max 1000

request.description:
The rolling ~/.spectro/logs/spectroscope.log as tail + incremental deltas: {content, offset}. 256 KB response cap; rotation resets to a fresh tail.

Fence: host+origin — Loopback fence plus Origin check: an Origin header, if present, must be loopback. REST clients send no Origin header, which counts as safe — requests pass. A manually added foreign Origin answers a blank 404.

Writes state: no

The scheduler's job-state map from ~/.spectro/jobs-state.json (what `spectroscope cron status` prints); empty when absent/corrupt.

Fence: none — No origin gating.

Writes state: no

Whether Docker and the compose v2 plugin are usable here: {docker, compose, remote, detail}. docker is ready/absent/stopped/unreachable, detail is one honest sentence. A DOCKER_HOST naming a remote daemon answers unreachable rather than a guess.

Fence: host+origin — Loopback fence plus Origin check: an Origin header, if present, must be loopback. REST clients send no Origin header, which counts as safe — requests pass. A manually added foreign Origin answers a blank 404.

Writes state: no

item.description: The stored session JSONL store: list, read, export, delete.

request.description:
List every stored session's metadata from the JSONL store (the sidebar list).

Fence: none — No origin gating.

Writes state: no

All parsed RunEvents of one session as JSON; 404 when unreadable.

Fence: none — No origin gating.

Writes state: no

The raw session JSONL, byte-identical, as an attachment (application/x-ndjson). Id shape-checked ([A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9-]*); 404 for foreign callers or malformed id.

Fence: host+origin — Loopback fence plus Origin check: an Origin header, if present, must be loopback. REST clients send no Origin header, which counts as safe — requests pass. A manually added foreign Origin answers a blank 404.

Writes state: no

Delete one stored session (JSONL + blob folder). 204 success, 400 malformed id, 404 unknown.

CAUTION: This really deletes the session, and it is the one destructive endpoint without an origin fence — the id shape check is the only guard. Point it at a throwaway home before replaying the whole collection.

item.name: config & onboarding
item.description: Active provider/model, the assembled system context, and saving an API key.

request.description:
Active provider/model/logLevel, image-key presence (booleans only), per-provider onboarding status incl. spectro-local.

Side effect: A ready provider establishes the 'provider-ready' leveling criterion — harmless, but a drift guard replaying the whole collection should know.

Fence: none — No origin gating.

Writes state: no

Save an API key to ~/.spectro/.env (0600). 200 {saved:true,provider}, 400 unknown provider/empty key, 404 fenced out. Value never echoed.

Body: KeyBody(String provider, String key). Replace the placeholder key before sending.

Fence: host+origin+json — Loopback fence plus Origin check, and the request must carry Content-Type: application/json — anything else is 415.

Writes state: yes

The assembled system context (system prompt, tools, skills, MCP servers, subagent profiles) for the server's working directory — stateless.

Fence: none — No origin gating.

Writes state: no

item.name: models & providers
item.description: Live model lists, reasoning capabilities, and the built-in local-model catalogue.

query.description: optional. anthropic | openai | lmstudio | openrouter | gemini | ollama

request.description:
Live model list for the picker (Anthropic Models API / /v1/models / ollama /api/tags), curated fallback; unknown provider answers [].

Fence: none — No origin gating.

Writes state: no

Reasoning capability of one (provider,model) pair — control/efforts/wire; live API overlay for anthropic/ollama/openrouter, static table otherwise. Never errors.

Fence: none — No origin gating.

Writes state: no

The built-in model catalogue: machine RAM/disk/binaryPresent plus every model's size, licence, download state and preflight verdict. Fenced — hardware fingerprint.

Fence: host — Loopback fence: the TCP peer must be loopback AND the Host header must be localhost/127.0.0.1/::1. A REST client passes automatically when it targets http://localhost:<port>. A LAN IP or rebound DNS name in the URL answers a blank 404.

Writes state: no

One model's download/presence state, polled for the progress bar. 404 for unknown ids.

Fence: host — Loopback fence: the TCP peer must be loopback AND the Host header must be localhost/127.0.0.1/::1. A REST client passes automatically when it targets http://localhost:<port>. A LAN IP or rebound DNS name in the URL answers a blank 404.

Writes state: no

Start (idempotent) one model's sha256-pinned download into ~/.spectro/models. Returns current status.

CAUTION: Downloads are gigabytes — do not include this in an automated replay.

Fence: host+origin — Loopback fence plus Origin check: an Origin header, if present, must be loopback. REST clients send no Origin header, which counts as safe — requests pass. A manually added foreign Origin answers a blank 404.

Writes state: yes

item.name: skills
item.description: Skills of both roots (user + project): list, disable, delete.

All skills of both roots (user ~/.spectro/skills + project <cwd>/.spectro/skills), disabled ones included: {skills:[{name,description,source,disabled}]}.

Fence: host+origin — Loopback fence plus Origin check: an Origin header, if present, must be loopback. REST clients send no Origin header, which counts as safe — requests pass. A manually added foreign Origin answers a blank 404.

Writes state: no

Flip the .disabled marker on a skill (user root wins when both roots carry it). 404 unknown.

Body: {disabled: boolean} — false re-enables.

Fence: host+origin — Loopback fence plus Origin check: an Origin header, if present, must be loopback. REST clients send no Origin header, which counts as safe — requests pass. A manually added foreign Origin answers a blank 404.

Writes state: yes

Delete a USER-root skill for good (seeding ledger keeps it away). 409 for a project skill, 404 unknown. Traversal-guarded.

CAUTION: Deletion is permanent — the seeding ledger will not re-seed it.

Fence: host+origin — Loopback fence plus Origin check: an Origin header, if present, must be loopback. REST clients send no Origin header, which counts as safe — requests pass. A manually added foreign Origin answers a blank 404.

Writes state: yes

item.name: workspace & files
item.description: The workspace tree, single-file preview, and the native folder chooser.

query.description: optional. the session whose resolved workspace to serve; absent = 409, there is no fallback

request.description:
That session's resolved workspace tree (dot-files and build/dep dirs hidden, depth 8, 2000-entry cap, honest truncated flag; a link out of the workspace is left out). 400 malformed session id, 404 no workspace folder, 409 no workspace resolved for this session.

Fence: host — Loopback fence: the TCP peer must be loopback AND the Host header must be localhost/127.0.0.1/::1. A REST client passes automatically when it targets http://localhost:<port>. A LAN IP or rebound DNS name in the URL answers a blank 404.

Writes state: no

One file for the preview pane, CSP-sandboxed. Real-path sandbox: no traversal and no symlink escape. 404 outside/hidden/missing, 413 over caps (2 MB text / 25 MB image), 415 binary.

Fence: host — Loopback fence: the TCP peer must be loopback AND the Host header must be localhost/127.0.0.1/::1. A REST client passes automatically when it targets http://localhost:<port>. A LAN IP or rebound DNS name in the URL answers a blank 404.

Writes state: no

Open the NATIVE macOS folder chooser on the server machine (blocks up to 120 s). 200 {path}, 204 cancel, 409 dialog already open, 501 non-macOS, 500 failure. Picks only — changes nothing.

CAUTION: Blocks until a human answers the dialog on the server machine — exclude it from automated replays.

Fence: none — No origin gating.

Writes state: no

item.name: images
item.description: The content-addressed image store and copying an image into a workspace.

request.description:
One generated image from the content-addressed store (~/.spectro/images). Name must match [0-9a-f]{64}.(png|jpg|webp) — 400 otherwise, 404 non-local/missing.

Fence: host — Loopback fence: the TCP peer must be loopback AND the Host header must be localhost/127.0.0.1/::1. A REST client passes automatically when it targets http://localhost:<port>. A LAN IP or rebound DNS name in the URL answers a blank 404.

Writes state: no

Copy a stored image into the session's workspace. 200 {path}, 400 malformed inputs, 404 unknown image/workspace, 409 target exists.

Body: CopyRequest(String file, String session, String name) — name optional (keeps store name; extension inherited).

Fence: host+origin+json — Loopback fence plus Origin check, and the request must carry Content-Type: application/json — anything else is 415.

Writes state: yes

item.name: import
item.description: Claude Code transcripts under ~/.claude/projects, for the import path.

request.description:
List *.jsonl Claude Code transcripts under ~/.claude/projects, newest first, capped at 300 rows. Answers {limitBytes, truncated, transcripts: [...]} — truncated says the row cap fired, limitBytes is the ceiling the content endpoint enforces. Absent store = empty list.

Fence: host — Loopback fence: the TCP peer must be loopback AND the Host header must be localhost/127.0.0.1/::1. A REST client passes automatically when it targets http://localhost:<port>. A LAN IP or rebound DNS name in the URL answers a blank 404.

Writes state: no

One transcript's raw JSONL for the import path, streamed. 400 non-.jsonl, 404 outside base/missing, 413 over 128 MiB.

Fence: host — Loopback fence: the TCP peer must be loopback AND the Host header must be localhost/127.0.0.1/::1. A REST client passes automatically when it targets http://localhost:<port>. A LAN IP or rebound DNS name in the URL answers a blank 404.

Writes state: no

item.name: leveling
item.description: The ladder: progress, surface visits, mode, reset, manual ticks.

request.description:
The ladder + this home's progress: mode, level, marks, remaining, history.

Fence: host+origin — Loopback fence plus Origin check: an Origin header, if present, must be loopback. REST clients send no Origin header, which counts as safe — requests pass. A manually added foreign Origin answers a blank 404.

Writes state: no

Report a surface was shown (how UI-only acts reach the ladder). Returns fresh state.

Body: VisitBody(String surface, String sessionId, Integer agentsShown) — surface required to record, others optional.

Fence: host+origin+json — Loopback fence plus Origin check, and the request must carry Content-Type: application/json — anything else is 415.

Writes state: yes

Switch the leveling mode. 400 unknown mode.

Body: ModeBody(String mode) — ladder | checklist | off, exact match; a typo is 400.

Fence: host+origin+json — Loopback fence plus Origin check, and the request must carry Content-Type: application/json — anything else is 415.

Writes state: yes

Restart the ladder from the dark frame, keeping the mode.

Body: No fields — an empty JSON object satisfies consumes=application/json.

Fence: host+origin+json — Loopback fence plus Origin check, and the request must carry Content-Type: application/json — anything else is 415.

Writes state: yes

Tick a criterion by hand — the receipt records origin=manual, forever.

Body: TickBody(String criterion). Unknown criteria are ignored by the recorder; state is still returned.

Fence: host+origin+json — Loopback fence plus Origin check, and the request must carry Content-Type: application/json — anything else is 415.

Writes state: yes

item.name: fleet
item.description: The fleet roster, per-node replay, and node control (stop / gate / spawn). The hub is opt-in via SPECTRO_HUB_PORT; without it the roster answers enabled:false and node routes answer 404.

request.description:
The fleet roster: {enabled, hubPort, nodes[]}. enabled:false with empty roster is a valid answer (hub is opt-in via SPECTRO_HUB_PORT).

Fence: host — Loopback fence: the TCP peer must be loopback AND the Host header must be localhost/127.0.0.1/::1. A REST client passes automatically when it targets http://localhost:<port>. A LAN IP or rebound DNS name in the URL answers a blank 404.

Writes state: no

Per-node replay from the bounded hub ring: {node, ringBounded:true, truncated, events[]}; 404 for unknown nodes.

Fence: host — Loopback fence: the TCP peer must be loopback AND the Host header must be localhost/127.0.0.1/::1. A REST client passes automatically when it targets http://localhost:<port>. A LAN IP or rebound DNS name in the URL answers a blank 404.

Writes state: no

Dispatch ctl{stop} to a node over the hub. 202 sent (best-effort, no ack), 404 not local/no fleet/unknown, 409 node already left.

Body: No fields — an empty JSON object satisfies consumes=application/json.

Fence: host+json — Loopback fence, and the request must carry Content-Type: application/json — anything else is 415.

Writes state: yes

Answer a parked permission gate on a fleet node. 202 sent, 400 missing callId/allow, 404, 409 node left.

Body: GateAnswer(String callId, Boolean allow) — both required; allow is boxed so a missing verdict is 400, never a silent deny.

Fence: host+json — Loopback fence, and the request must carry Content-Type: application/json — anything else is 415.

Writes state: yes

Spawn a readonly fleet node. 202 {id,note}, 400 bad input, 429 spawn cap, 500 process failure.

Body: SpawnRequest(String prompt, String context, String role, String id, boolean linger) — prompt+context required; context matches [A-Za-z0-9._-]; the node is FORCED readonly.

CAUTION: Requires the server to run with SPECTRO_ALLOW_SPAWN set AND a running hub — otherwise every answer is 404, by design.

Fence: host+json+optin — Loopback fence plus Content-Type: application/json, and the server must run with SPECTRO_ALLOW_SPAWN set (default off). Disabled and fenced-out both answer 404 — there is no enablement oracle.

Writes state: yes

item.name: translate
item.description: Session translation: engine availability and the streaming translate call.

request.description:
Which translation engines this install can offer: {local:{available,...}, cloud:{available,...}} with reasons no-binary | no-model | needs-key | provider-is-local.

Fence: host+origin — Loopback fence plus Origin check: an Origin header, if present, must be loopback. REST clients send no Origin header, which counts as safe — requests pass. A manually added foreign Origin answers a blank 404.

Writes state: no

Translate session passages, streamed NDJSON ({meta}, per-unit {unit,delta}/{unit,end}|{unit,error}, {done}). Never writes — the record survives. 400/413/503 as bounds/readiness dictate.

Body: TranslateBody(engine local|cloud, target en|de|uk|ru|fr|es|..., units[max 40, 4000 chars each, 60000 total]). The cloud engine spends the operator's API key.

Fence: host+origin+json — Loopback fence plus Origin check, and the request must carry Content-Type: application/json — anything else is 415.

Writes state: no

item.name: explain
item.description: LLM interpretation of a run digest, streamed as NDJSON.

request.description:
LLM interpretation of a run digest, streamed as NDJSON ({meta}, {delta}..., {done}|{error}). 400 blank, 413 oversize, 503 no provider ready.

Body: ExplainBody(String digest, String lang) — digest required, max 200000 chars; lang en | de.

CAUTION: Spends the operator's API key on every call.

Fence: host+origin+json — Loopback fence plus Origin check, and the request must carry Content-Type: application/json — anything else is 415.

Writes state: no

Speech-to-text: webm→WAV (ffmpeg)→whisper-cli→{text}. 503 with setup hint when STT not installed, 500 temp-dir/interrupt. Sent without a body — as this request ships — Spring answers 400 (Required request body is missing) before the controller runs.

Body: Send the raw webm/opus recording as the request body (curl --data-binary @recording.webm). No JSON wrapper.

Fence: none — No origin gating.

Writes state: no

Probe the configured OTLP exporter endpoint with an empty batch: {configured:false} | {configured:true, endpoint, ok, message?}. Auth never echoed.

Fence: host+origin — Loopback fence plus Origin check: an Origin header, if present, must be loopback. REST clients send no Origin header, which counts as safe — requests pass. A manually added foreign Origin answers a blank 404.

Writes state: no
